question: A circle is the set of all points in a plane that are at the same distance from:
urdu_translation: circle ان تمام points کا set ہے جو plane میں کس سے برابر فاصلے پر ہوں؟
A: A fixed line / ایک مقررہ خط
B: Two fixed points / دو مقررہ نقاط
C: A fixed point / ایک مقررہ نقطہ
D: A moving line / ایک متحرک خط
correct_answer: C | A fixed point / ایک مقررہ نقطہ

question: What is the line segment joining the centre of a circle to a point on the circle called?
urdu_translation: circle کے centre کو circumference کے ایک point سے ملانے والا line segment کیا کہلاتا ہے؟

question: The measure of a radial segment is called the:
urdu_translation: radial segment کی measure کیا کہلاتی ہے؟

question: What is the length of the boundary of a circle called?
urdu_translation: circle کی boundary کی length کیا کہلاتی ہے؟

question: Which formula gives the circumference C of a circle of radius r?
urdu_translation: radius r والے circle کے circumference C کا formula کون سا ہے؟

question: A line segment joining any two distinct points of a circle is called a:
urdu_translation: circle کے کسی دو distinct points کو ملانے والا line segment کیا کہلاتا ہے؟

question: Which chord passes through the centre of a circle?
urdu_translation: کون سا chord circle کے centre سے گزرتا ہے؟

question: A semicircle is bounded by a diameter and:
urdu_translation: semicircle ایک diameter اور کس سے bounded ہوتا ہے؟
A: A circumference cut by that diameter / اس diameter سے کٹا ہوا circumference
B: Two radii only / صرف دو radii
C: A chord only / صرف ایک chord
D: A tangent line / ایک tangent line
correct_answer: A | A circumference cut by that diameter / اس diameter سے کٹا ہوا circumference

question: Any part of the circumference of a circle is called an:
urdu_translation: circle کے circumference کے کسی part کو کیا کہتے ہیں؟

question: Which arc is smaller than the arc of a semicircle?
urdu_translation: کون سی arc semicircle کی arc سے چھوٹی ہوتی ہے؟

question: Which arc is greater than the arc of a semicircle?
urdu_translation: کون سی arc semicircle کی arc سے بڑی ہوتی ہے؟

question: The region enclosed between a chord and the arc cut off by it is called a:
urdu_translation: chord اور اس سے cut ہونے والی arc کے درمیان enclosed region کیا کہلاتا ہے؟
A: Sector of a circle / circle کا قطاع
D: Segment of a circle / circle کا قطعہ
correct_answer: D | Segment of a circle / circle کا قطعہ

question: The region enclosed between two radii and an arc is called a:
urdu_translation: دو radii اور ایک arc کے درمیان enclosed region کیا کہلاتا ہے؟
A: Sector of a circle / circle کا قطاع
B: Segment of a circle / circle کا قطعہ
correct_answer: A | Sector of a circle / circle کا قطاع

question: An angle formed by joining a point on the arc of a segment to the endpoints of its chord is called:
urdu_translation: segment کی arc کے point کو chord کے endpoints سے ملانے پر بننے والا angle کیا کہلاتا ہے؟
C: Angle in the segment / segment میں زاویہ
correct_answer: C | Angle in the segment / segment میں زاویہ

question: An angle whose vertex lies on the circumference and whose arms meet the endpoints of an arc is called:
urdu_translation: وہ angle جس کا vertex circumference پر ہو اور arms arc کے endpoints سے ملیں، کیا کہلاتا ہے؟
B: Angle standing upon an arc / arc پر قائم زاویہ
correct_answer: B | Angle standing upon an arc / arc پر قائم زاویہ

question: A straight line cutting the circumference of a circle at two distinct points is called a:
urdu_translation: circle کے circumference کو دو distinct points پر cut کرنے والی straight line کیا کہلاتی ہے؟

question: An angle formed at the centre by the endpoints of an arc or chord is called a:
urdu_translation: arc یا chord کے endpoints کو centre سے ملانے پر بننے والا angle کیا کہلاتا ہے؟
D: Angle in a segment / segment میں زاویہ

question: What is the sum of central angles of a circle having no interior points in common?
urdu_translation: circle کے ایسے central angles کا sum کیا ہوتا ہے جن کے interior points common نہ ہوں؟

topic: 8.1.1 One and Only One Circle Through Three Non-Collinear Points
8.1.1 One and Only One Circle Through Three Non-Collinear Points
question: How many circles can pass through three non-collinear points?
urdu_translation: three non-collinear points سے کتنے circles گزر سکتے ہیں؟

topic: 8.1.1 One and Only One Circle Through Three Non-Collinear Points
question: Why can a circle not be drawn through more than two points lying on one straight line?
urdu_translation: ایک straight line پر موجود two سے زیادہ points سے circle کیوں نہیں گزر سکتا؟
A: Every chord is a radius / ہر chord radius ہوتا ہے
B: All arcs are equal / تمام arcs برابر ہوتی ہیں
C: A diameter is not a chord / diameter chord نہیں ہوتا
D: A circle cannot contain three collinear points / circle میں three collinear points نہیں ہو سکتے
correct_answer: D | A circle cannot contain three collinear points / circle میں three collinear points نہیں ہو سکتے

topic: 8.1.1 One and Only One Circle Through Three Non-Collinear Points
question: If two circles have three common points, what follows?
urdu_translation: اگر two circles کے three common points ہوں تو کیا نتیجہ نکلتا ہے؟
A: The circles coincide / circles coincide کرتے ہیں
B: They are perpendicular / وہ perpendicular ہوتے ہیں
C: They have different centres / ان کے centres مختلف ہوتے ہیں
D: They have no common chord / ان کا common chord نہیں ہوتا
correct_answer: A | The circles coincide / circles coincide کرتے ہیں

topic: 8.1.2–8.1.3 Perpendicular from the Centre and Bisection of a Chord
8.1.2–8.1.3 Perpendicular from the Centre and Bisection of a Chord
question: A line drawn from the centre of a circle perpendicular to a chord:
urdu_translation: circle کے centre سے chord پر drawn perpendicular line کیا کرتی ہے؟
A: Bisects the chord / chord کو bisect کرتی ہے
B: Doubles the chord / chord کو double کرتی ہے
C: Becomes a tangent / tangent بن جاتی ہے
D: Bisects the circumference / circumference کو bisect کرتی ہے
correct_answer: A | Bisects the chord / chord کو bisect کرتی ہے

topic: 8.1.2–8.1.3 Perpendicular from the Centre and Bisection of a Chord
question: If a line from the centre of a circle bisects a chord, then it is:
urdu_translation: اگر centre سے drawn line chord کو bisect کرے تو وہ chord کے ساتھ کیا ہوگی؟
A: Parallel to the chord / chord کے parallel
B: A tangent to the circle / circle کی tangent
C: Perpendicular to the chord / chord پر perpendicular
D: Equal to the chord / chord کے برابر
correct_answer: C | Perpendicular to the chord / chord پر perpendicular

topic: 8.1.2–8.1.3 Perpendicular from the Centre and Bisection of a Chord
question: A chord is 8 cm long and the radius is 5 cm. What is the perpendicular distance from the centre to the chord?
urdu_translation: chord 8 cm اور radius 5 cm ہے۔ centre سے chord کا perpendicular distance معلوم کریں۔

topic: 8.1.2–8.1.3 Perpendicular from the Centre and Bisection of a Chord
question: A chord is 24 m long in a circle of radius 13 m. What is its distance from the centre?
urdu_translation: radius 13 m والے circle میں chord 24 m ہے۔ centre سے chord کا distance معلوم کریں۔

topic: 8.1.4–8.1.5 Congruent Chords and Distance from the Centre
8.1.4–8.1.5 Congruent Chords and Distance from the Centre
question: If two chords of the same circle are congruent, then they are:
urdu_translation: same circle کے two congruent chords centre سے کیسے ہوتے ہیں؟
A: Equidistant from the centre / centre سے برابر فاصلے پر
B: Parallel in every case / ہر صورت parallel
D: Perpendicular to each other / ایک دوسرے پر perpendicular
correct_answer: A | Equidistant from the centre / centre سے برابر فاصلے پر

topic: 8.1.4–8.1.5 Congruent Chords and Distance from the Centre
question: If two chords of a circle are equidistant from the centre, then the chords are:
urdu_translation: اگر circle کے two chords centre سے equidistant ہوں تو chords کیسے ہوں گے؟

topic: 8.1.4–8.1.5 Congruent Chords and Distance from the Centre
question: Two chords are each 8 m from the centre. If one chord is 14 m long, what is the length of the other chord?
urdu_translation: two chords centre سے 8 m دور ہیں۔ ایک chord 14 m ہے تو دوسرے کی length کیا ہوگی؟

question: If two arcs of the same circle are congruent, their corresponding chords are:
urdu_translation: same circle کی two congruent arcs کے corresponding chords کیسے ہوتے ہیں؟

question: If two chords of the same circle are congruent, their corresponding arcs are:
urdu_translation: same circle کے two congruent chords کی corresponding arcs کیسی ہوتی ہیں؟

question: In a circle, chord AB is equal to chord CD. Which relation between the corresponding arcs is correct?
urdu_translation: circle میں chord AB، chord CD کے برابر ہے۔ corresponding arcs کے درمیان درست relation کون سا ہے؟

question: Equal chords of a circle subtend central angles that are:
urdu_translation: circle کے equal chords centre پر کیسے angles subtend کرتے ہیں؟
D: Always right angles / ہمیشہ قائمہ زاویے

question: If two central angles of a circle are equal, their corresponding chords are:
urdu_translation: اگر circle کے two central angles برابر ہوں تو corresponding chords کیسے ہوں گے؟

question: Two equal central angles subtend chords PQ and RS. If PQ = 4 cm, what is RS?
urdu_translation: two equal central angles chords PQ اور RS subtend کرتے ہیں۔ اگر PQ = 4 cm ہو تو RS کیا ہوگا؟

question: The central angle of a minor arc measures:
urdu_translation: minor arc کا central angle کتنا measure کرتا ہے؟

question: The central angle of a major arc measures:
urdu_translation: major arc کا central angle کتنا measure کرتا ہے؟

question: The central angle of a semicircle measures:
urdu_translation: semicircle کا central angle کتنا ہوتا ہے؟

question: The distance of any point on the circumference from the centre equals the:
urdu_translation: circumference کے کسی point کا centre سے distance کس کے برابر ہوتا ہے؟

question: A chord is 10 cm long and its perpendicular distance from the centre is 6 cm. What is the radius?
urdu_translation: chord 10 cm اور centre سے perpendicular distance 6 cm ہے۔ radius معلوم کریں۔

question: A 20 cm chord is bisected by a perpendicular from the centre of length 10 cm. What is the radius?
urdu_translation: 20 cm chord کو centre سے 10 cm کے perpendicular نے bisect کیا ہے۔ radius معلوم کریں۔

question: In two congruent circles, congruent minor arcs correspond to chords that are:
urdu_translation: two congruent circles میں congruent minor arcs کے corresponding chords کیسے ہوتے ہیں؟
